blocks.tamil_translation: wives, your family, the wealth (of yours) which you have earned, the trade (of yours) whose loss you fear, and the homes (of yours) with which you are content are dearer to you than Allah, than His Messenger and than striving in His path, then wait until Allah brings His command (of punishment); and Allah does not guide the sinful people.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَأَنْفِقُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ وَلَا تُلْقُوا بِأَيْدِيكُمْ إِلَي التَّهْلُكَةِ ۚ وَأَحْسِنُوا ۚ إِنَّ اللهَ يُحِبُّ الْمُحْسِنِين۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: Spend in the path of Allah, and (by not spending so) do not throw (yourselves) into destruction with your own hands; and do good; indeed Allah loves those who do good.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: لَقَدْ أُخِفْتُ فِي اللهِ وَمَا يُخَافُ أَحَدٌ، وَلَقَدْ أُوذِيتُ فِي اللهِ لَمْ يُؤْذَ أَحَدٌ، وَلَقَدْ أَتَتْ عَلَيَّ ثَلَاثُونَ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ وَمَالِي وَلِبِلَالٍ طَعَامٌ يَأْكُلُهُ ذُو كَبِدٍ إِلَّا شَيْءٌ يُوَارِيهِ إِبِطُ بِلَالٍ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقال: هذا حديث حسن صحيح، باب احاديث عائشة وانس...، رقم:٢٤٧٢
blocks.tamil_translation: “Because of calling towards the sacred Din, I was made to fear as no one else was made to fear. I was persecuted in the path of Allah Ta'ala as no one else was persecuted. For me and Bilal, not even as much food as a living creature eats
